ideas.pain_point: Gamers are frustrated by high prices for new and old games, feeling they don't get enough content for their money: "No Way Im Paying 80$ For Games When There Are Better Games With More Content That Came Out For Less".
Non-gamers struggle to pick appropriate video game gifts, leading to disappointment: "The love of my life (who knows nothing about gaming) gifted me this for my B-day" (implying a poor choice).

Gamers are frustrated by companies shutting down games, making them unplayable, and demanding destruction of copies: "Ubisoft Wants Gamers To Destroy All Copies of A Game Once It Goes Offline" and "Stop Killing Games has Reached 1,000,000 Signatures."

Indie developers face confusion and frustration with award eligibility criteria, leading to missed opportunities: "Megabonk Developer Withdraws Game From The Game Awards, Saying It Doesn't Qualify for Debut Indie - ".
Gamers and developers are concerned about the use of AI in game development, with indie devs using 'AI free' as a sales pitch: "Indie game developers have a new sales pitch: ‘AI free’"
